_schema.id: string  | SLUG — must be unique globally. Convention: 'exam-config-<cert-slug>-s<N>'
_schema.certificationId: string  | FK → certification.id (slug). Must match the cert's id exactly.
_schema.name: string  | Human-readable name shown in the UI.
_schema.description: string  | Short description of this practice set.
_schema.duration: integer | Exam time limit in minutes. Range: 15–480.
_schema.totalQuestions: integer | Number of questions drawn per session. Range: 5–500.
_schema.passingScore: integer | Minimum score % to pass. Range: 0–100.
